Hamilton Park Farmers Market 2026
events.description:
Join us at the Hamilton Park Farmers Market, your midweek destination for fresh, local, and thoughtfully crafted food and goods. Each week, we’re proud to feature farm-fresh produce from Stony Hill Farm alongside a curated selection of specialty vendors.

Browse a variety of offerings including our long time vendor Pickles and Olives, fresh seafood from Scale Fish Market, and prepared foods perfect for dinner. You can also find baked goods, candles, personal care products, and more. You can even take advantage of convenient services like on-site knife sharpening while you shop.

On the first and second Wednesdays of each month, enjoy live entertainment that adds to the vibrant, community atmosphere of the market.

Whether you’re shopping for the week, grabbing a bite, or simply enjoying the park, the Hamilton Park Farmers Market is a welcoming space to connect with local vendors and neighbors.

events.title: Flame (The Experience) 2026
events.description: Flame (The Experience) for a one night only event presented by Ruby Hawk Productions and Art House Productions in Jersey City, New Jersey. Based on Brown’s 2021 poetry collection Flame, which tells the story of a failed twin flame romance, Flame (The Experience) takes the poetry off the page and brings it to life through a sizzling, multi-sensory theatrical experience told through sight, sound, monologues, and movement.

events.title: Jodeci – Jersey City
events.description:
Get ready to experience an unforgettable night as Jodeci takes the stage for their highly anticipated concert, “”Jodeci – Jersey City,”” at the iconic Landmark Loews Theatre. Nestled in the heart of Jersey City, this historic venue boasts a stunning atmosphere that perfectly complements the smooth R&B vibes of the legendary group. With its grand architecture and intimate setting, the Loews Theatre is the ideal backdrop for an evening filled with soulful melodies and nostalgic hits.

Join fellow fans for a night of electrifying performances that will have you singing along and dancing in your seat. The energy will be palpable as Jodeci delivers their timeless classics and new favorites, making this a must-see event for R&B lovers. Don’t miss out on this chance to witness music history in the making—secure your spot now and be part of the magic at Jodeci – Jersey City!
